name: Mekong Half Marathon
short_description: A half marathon held in Vientiane, Laos on September 27, 2026, offering 21.1km, 10km, and 5km distance options.
ai_summary: The Mekong Half Marathon takes place on September 27, 2026 in Vientiane, Laos, at the Xaysetha Economic Zone. faqs.question: When is the Mekong Half Marathon held?
faqs.answer: The Mekong Half Marathon is scheduled to take place on September 27, 2026. The event will be held in Vientiane, Laos, at the Xaysetha Economic Zone venue. faqs.question: What distance options are available?

This range of distances allows runners of varying experience levels and fitness goals to select the race length that best suits their training and personal objectives.

faqs.question: Who organizes the Mekong Half Marathon?
faqs.answer: The Mekong Half Marathon is organized by Green Step. This organization is responsible for coordinating the event, which takes place at the Xaysetha Economic Zone in Vientiane, Laos, and includes multiple race distances for participants including the primary 21.1km half marathon distance.
